subject.title: feat(ui): scroll truncated sidebar session names on hover

question: Should this PR be narrowed back to the sidebar hover-marquee change, or intentionally rescoped to carry the unrelated iOS, ClickClack, sessions/category, CI, docs/changelog, and generated i18n changes?
rationale: The current head is technically reviewable only after a human decides whether the broad bundle is accidental branch contamination or an intentional multi-surface product/API change set.

options.title: Narrow to hover marquee
options.body: Keep only the Control UI hover helper, keyed sidebar row, CSS, and focused tests in this PR, and move the unrelated work to separate PRs.

options.title: Rescope as a bundle
options.body: Retitle and rewrite the PR body, then require owner review and proof for the iOS, ClickClack, sessions/category, CI, and generated-output changes before merge.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: If the branch cannot be safely narrowed, pause it or open a fresh focused replacement PR for the hover-marquee feature.

recommendation.title: Narrow to hover marquee
recommendation.body: Keep only the Control UI hover helper, keyed sidebar row, CSS, and focused tests in this PR, and move the unrelated work to separate PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the PR assignee, authored the current sidebar implementation, and pushed the latest broad head commit.
